items.text: the Pack library offers Water and the Frost starter only for now; the glass and drum sets come back when the panel can show which packs are playing
in the index, Picture comes before Sound, the order of the bar (Input, then Sound)
the flow caption reads 0 to 100%, like the ring, and no longer shows when the app opens
the rings' switch list is a wheel: scroll it, and the ring in the lens grows while the others shrink and fade; tap any ring to switch
In is called Input everywhere: the bar button, its ring, its shelf, the guide and the paths
the Input button on the bar wears its own icon again, the arrow into a tray, as its ring does; the six dots mean a ring
the Picture section in the index has its own picture icon
the Input ring's top caret opens Picture's panel (presets, drive, zoom, turn); hold the Input button for its shelf
the rings' switch list rows are 40 px, an easy finger target, still with no gaps
the rings' switch list is tighter, each ring has its icon beside its name, and In is listed as Input
in Auto play, the style tile has its own icon, particles in motion; the droplet is only ever color
wetness has its own icon, a sound and its echoes in a room, on the Sound shelf and in the Sound ring; the droplet is for color
in Pack, each sound's switch says whether it plays: a lit check when on, an empty ring when off, and an off sound's row dims
in Pack, the timing pill (every beat, eighths…) has its label, How often
on big windows the pills, tiles and beads in the shelves and panels were scaled up twice; they now grow once with the bar (a 72 px bar's pills are 48 px, not 64)
the In ring opened from the bar now has its switch on the bottom edge, the caret that lists the other rings, as it does on the stage
Capture's red dot means one thing, recording video. A GIF now shows a light dot with its loop arrow, like a still shows a light dot, so the button's icon always says what it will do
picking a water look or a part's color now ticks the Material path's color step
